The Gate 47 correction is saved and I replied to Pree in the thread, but the old Dock 23 note is still active, so the team notes now give two sites for the lane.

- **Saved:** GBrain now has "the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47". The note's source line says it replaces the Dock 23 entry. My reply to Pree says it was corrected.
- **Not removed:** I tried to withdraw the Dock 23 note, but this connection isn't allowed to remove it. Nothing was forgotten. Anyone looking up Marrow Agrisupply will see both sites; only the source line says Gate 47 is current.

To clear it, the brain owner needs to run `gbrain forget 1` on the brain host.
